'''''Hacettepe Journal of Mathematics and Statistics''''' is an international [[Peer review|peer-reviewed]] open-access journal (with no article processing/publishing charge) devoted to the publication of original research papers and occasional surveys of a suitably high standard, written in English, on all aspects of Mathematics and [[Statistics]]. The journal is published by [[Hacettepe University]] Faculty of Science. It is currently hosted on [https://dergipark.org.tr/en/ DergiPark].

==Abstracting and indexing==
According to the ''[[Journal Citation Reports]]'', the journal has a 2023 [[impact factor]] of 0.7 .<ref name=WoS>{{cite book |year=2015 |chapter=Hacettepe Journal of Mathematics and Statistics|title=[[Journal Citation Reports|2014 Journal Citation Reports]] |publisher=[[Thomson Reuters]] |edition=Science |series=[[Web of Science]]}}</ref> The journal is indexed in SCI-EXP, [[Journal Citation Reports]], Mathematical Reviews, Zentralblatt MATH, Current Index to Statistics, Statistical Theory & Method Abstracts, [[SCOPUS]], Tübitak-Ulakbim.<ref name="hacettepe">{{cite web|url=http://www.hjms.hacettepe.edu.tr/|title=Hacettepe Üniversitesi - HJMS|publisher=hjms.hacettepe.edu.tr|accessdate=2016-01-07|archive-date=2019-02-11|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190211134351/http://www.hjms.hacettepe.edu.tr/|url-status=dead}}</ref>
